stopConditions: Concurrent modification of the test lane, immutable source or canonical Brain
Material is neither synthetic nor explicitly owned by Olivier
A client, prospect, real phone number, provider, OAuth or external transport becomes necessary

A shared or non-disposable database becomes necessary
A mutation cannot be restored byte-exactly

Claiming founder observation from a synthetic fixture
